import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 5005;
    static final long inf = 1000000007L;
    static int n, m, startPoint, endPoint;
    static int[] a = new int[maxn];

    static class Edge {
        int from, to, cap, flow, cost;
        public Edge(int from, int to, int cap, int flow, int cost) {
            this.from = from; this.to = to; this.cap = cap; this.flow = flow; this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int n, m;
        ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<Integer>[] g = new ArrayList[maxn];
        int[] inq = new int[maxn];
        int[] d = new int[maxn];
        int[] p = new int[maxn];
        int[] a = new int[maxn];

        public MCMF() {
            for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        void init(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                g[i].clear();
            }
            e.clear();
        }

        void add(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
            e.add(new Edge(from, to, cap, 0, cost));
            e.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0, -cost));
            int m = e.size();
            g[from].add(m - 2);
            g[to].add(m - 1);
        }

        boolean bellman(int s, int t, int[] flowRef, int[] costRef) {
            Arrays.fill(d, (int) inf);
            Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
            d[s] = 0; inq[s] = 1; p[s] = -1; a[s] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.offer(s);
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                inq[u] = 0;
                for (int i : g[u]) {
                    Edge ee = e.get(i);
                    if (ee.cap > ee.flow && d[ee.to] > d[u] + ee.cost) {
                        d[ee.to] = d[u] + ee.cost;
                        p[ee.to] = i;
                        a[ee.to] = Math.min(a[u], ee.cap - ee.flow);
                        if (inq[ee.to] == 0) {
                            Q.offer(ee.to);
                            inq[ee.to] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (d[t] == (int) inf)
                return false;
            flowRef[0] += a[t];
            costRef[0] += d[t] * a[t];
            int u = t;
            while (u != s) {
                Edge e1 = e.get(p[u]);
                e1.flow += a[t];
                e.get(p[u] ^ 1).flow -= a[t];
                u = e1.from;
            }
            return true;
        }

        long minCost(int s, int t) {
            int[] flowRef = new int[1];
            int[] costRef = new int[1];
            long totalCost = 0;
            flowRef[0] = 0;
            costRef[0] = 0;
            while (bellman(s, t, flowRef, costRef));
            return costRef[0];
        }
    }

    static class FastReader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;
        public FastReader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }
            return st.nextToken();
        }
        int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastReader fr = new FastReader();
        n = fr.nextInt();
        m = fr.nextInt();
        int k = fr.nextInt();
        int c = fr.nextInt();
        int d = fr.nextInt();

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = fr.nextInt();
        }

        startPoint = 0;
        endPoint = n * 100 + 1;

        MCMF solve = new MCMF();
        solve.init(endPoint + 1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            solve.add(startPoint, 1 + (a[i] - 1) * 100, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 100; j++) {
                int p = (i - 1) * 100;
                solve.add(p + j, p + j + 1, (int) inf, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= 100; i++) {
            solve.add(i, endPoint, (int) inf, 0);
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            int x = fr.nextInt();
            int y = fr.nextInt();

            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                int p = (x - 1) * 100 + i;
                int pp = (y - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; j++) {
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1)) + c);
                }
            }

            for (int i = 1; i < 100; i++) {
                int p = (y - 1) * 100 + i;
                int pp = (x - 1) * 100 + i + 1;
                for (int j = 1; j <= 50; j++) {
                    solve.add(p, pp, 1, d * (j * j - (j - 1) * (j - 1)) + c);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve.minCost(startPoint, endPoint));
    }
}
